reason: Fees and payments are handled at the Bursary; the banks by the SRC take payments too.
reason_ha: Ana biyan kuɗin makaranta a Bursary; bankunan da ke kusa da SRC ma suna karɓar biya.

reason: Registration, admission and clearance problems are sorted at the Registry. Online course forms can be filled at the ICT Park.
reason_ha: Ana warware matsalar rajista da shiga makaranta a Registry. Ana iya cike fom ɗin kwas a ICT Park.

reason: Course registration starts at your department; the Registry handles problems.
reason_ha: Rajistar kwas tana farawa a sashenka; Registry tana warware matsaloli.

reason: The New Commercial Area by the Science Complex has the most food spots.
reason_ha: Wurin kasuwanci na kusa da Science Complex yana da wuraren abinci da yawa.

reason: The Central Mosque near Gate 3 holds Friday prayers; there are smaller mosques across campus.
reason_ha: Masallacin Juma'a yana kusa da Ƙofa ta 3; akwai ƙananan masallatai a ko'ina.

reason: The Chapel of Joy and the Catholic Church are on the east side.
reason_ha: Chapel of Joy da cocin Katolika suna gefen gabas.

reason: The University Clinic is beside the Faculty of Law.
reason_ha: Asibitin jami'a yana gefen Faculty of Law.

reason: ATMs and POS are at the New Commercial Area, by the SRC and on the Education side.
reason_ha: Akwai ATM da POS a wurin kasuwanci, kusa da SRC da gefen Education.

reason: The Main Library is the main place to read; it stays open late.
reason_ha: Babban laburare shi ne wurin karatu; yana buɗe har dare.

reason: Male hostels are in the south-east; female hostels are on the east side.
reason_ha: Hostel ɗin maza suna kudu maso gabas; na mata suna gefen gabas.

reason: Computer-based tests hold at the ICT Park; big written exams often hold in the Multipurpose Halls.
reason_ha: Ana yin jarabawar kwamfuta a ICT Park; manyan jarabawa a Multipurpose Hall.

reason: The football pitch is in the south of the campus.
The Vice-Chancellor's office is at the Senate Building.
Kekes and buses wait at the Main Gate; Gate 3 is the other way out.
reason_ha: Keke da motoci suna jira a Babban Ƙofa; Ƙofa ta 3 ita ce ɗayar hanyar fita.

reason: The SRC secretariat handles student complaints and union matters.
reason_ha: Ofishin SRC yana kula da ƙorafe-ƙorafen ɗalibai.

reason: The Fire Service is in the north; the Clinic handles medical emergencies.
reason_ha: Jami'an kashe gobara suna arewa; asibiti yana kula da gaggawar lafiya.

reason: The Zoological Park is on the east side.
reason_ha: Gidan namun daji yana gefen gabas.

reason: Pre-degree and remedial students belong to SBRS.
reason_ha: Ɗaliban pre-degree da remedial suna ƙarƙashin SBRS.
